data.name: AppSubtitle
data.value: Live processor and graphics usage and temperature

data.name: EmptyTitle
data.value: No processors or graphics adapters found

data.name: EmptySubtitle
data.value: HW Monitor could not see a CPU or GPU on this PC.

data.name: StatusTempsSubtitle
data.value: The sensor service is running, but package temperature is still missing. Install the PawnIO driver and restart the service. WinRing0 is not used.

data.name: StatusServiceTitle
data.value: Install sensor service for CPU temperature

data.name: StatusServiceSubtitle
data.value: CPU and integrated graphics temperatures need HW Monitor Sensor Service. Usage is still shown.

data.name: CoolAutoIdleSubtitle
data.value: Auto is watching the processor temperature.

data.name: CoolOnSubtitle
data.value: Maximum processor state is limited on the active power scheme.

data.name: CoolOffSubtitle
data.value: Click to limit processor turbo on the active power scheme.

data.name: CoolAutoSubtitle
data.value: Turned on automatically because the processor stayed hot.

data.name: CoolFailed
data.value: Cool Mode could not change the active power scheme. Start Command Palette as administrator and try again.

data.name: CoolReadFailed
data.value: Cool Mode could not read the active power scheme.

data.name: SettingRefreshDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page and Dock. How often readings refresh. The allowed range is 500 to 3000 milliseconds.

data.name: SettingCompactDescription
data.value: List. Hides cores on the cores page unless that core is set to Show.

data.name: SettingThresholdDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page and Dock. Warm from is the top of the Cool band. Hot and Critical stay above the cooler levels.

data.name: SettingColorDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page and Dock. Choose a named color. Choose Custom to use the hex field for this band.

data.name: SettingCoolMaxDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode. Maximum processor state on the active power scheme while Cool Mode is on. 99 disables turbo on most processors.

data.name: SettingCoolBoostDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode. Also sets processor boost mode, then restores the original value when Cool Mode turns off.

data.name: SettingBoostChoiceLabel
data.value: Boost mode while Cool Mode is on

data.name: SettingBoostChoiceDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode. Applied on the active power scheme while Cool Mode is on and boost limiting is enabled.

data.name: SettingAutoDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode auto-trigger. Turns Cool Mode on after the processor package stays hot, and off after it stays cooler. A Cool Mode session started by hand is left on.

data.name: SettingDeviceShortDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page and Dock. Leave empty to keep the default. Hardware id: {0}

data.name: SettingDeviceFullDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page. Leave empty to keep the detected hardware name.

data.name: SettingDeviceVisibilityDescription
data.value: Default uses the normal layout. Show forces the row on. Hide removes it.

data.name: SettingDeviceListDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page. Default follows compact mode. Show forces the row on. Hide removes it.

data.name: SettingDeviceDockDescription
data.value: Applies to the Dock only. Default shows a package or adapter and hides a core. Show forces the item on. Hide removes it.

data.name: SettingGroupGeneralHelp
data.value: Refresh, which rows the list shows, and whether dock icons use temperature colors.

data.name: SettingGroupColorsHelp
data.value: Tags on the list and icon color on the Dock use these bands.

data.name: SettingGroupCoolHelp
data.value: Cool Mode only changes the active Windows power scheme. It does not change fans or embedded-controller registers.

data.name: SettingGroupDevicesHelp
data.value: Names and visibility are stored against each device's hardware id.

data.name: SettingGroupDevicesEmpty
data.value: No devices yet. Rows appear here after a processor or graphics adapter is detected.

data.name: SettingDockColorDescription
data.value: Applies to the Dock only. Tints each device icon with its temperature color. Unknown temperatures keep the neutral icon.

data.name: SettingCustomHexDescription
data.value: Applies to the list page and Dock only when Custom is selected for this band.

data.name: SettingAutoOnDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode auto-trigger. Package temperature that starts the on timer.

data.name: SettingAutoOnSecondsDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode auto-trigger. How long the package must stay at or above the on temperature.

data.name: SettingAutoOffDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode auto-trigger. Package temperature that starts the off timer.

data.name: SettingAutoOffSecondsDescription
data.value: Used by Cool Mode auto-trigger. How long the package must stay at or below the off temperature.

data.name: SettingAdvancedHelp
data.value: Custom hex. List + Dock. Used when it differs from the selected swatch.

data.name: CoresEmptySubtitle
data.value: Compact mode hides cores unless a core is set to Show.

data.name: SettingsSaved
data.value: Saved. The list and Dock use these values now.

data.name: SettingsEmpty
data.value: Settings could not be read. Nothing was changed.

data.name: SettingsNumberIgnored
data.value: {0} was not a whole number, so it was left unchanged.

data.name: SettingsNumberLimited
data.value: {0} was limited to {1}. Allowed range is {2} to {3}.

data.name: SettingsHexIgnored
data.value: {0} custom hex was not a color, so the previous color was kept.

data.name: SettingsBandsReordered
data.value: Temperature bands were kept in order: Cool below {0}, Warm from {1}, Hot from {2}, Critical from {3}.

data.name: SettingsAutoOffLowered
data.value: Auto Cool off was lowered to {0} so it stays below the on temperature.
